posts.title: What do I say when a team member asks for a promotion they are not ready for?
posts.description: When someone asks for a promotion you cannot yet support, vague encouragement leaves them with hope but no information. Here are five things to say that are honest, protect the relationship and turn “not yet” into a plan with evidence and a review date. posts.title: Why does my team stay quiet when I ask for ideas?
posts.description: When you ask your team for ideas and get silence, it is tempting to read it as a lack of interest. Research on voice and silence suggests people often hold back because speaking up feels risky and live discussion makes thinking out loud hard.
